This game does everything it sets out to do with flair, style, and satisfying gameplay. It is a roguelite spin on a high movement based FPS playing field. It sort of reminds me of gunfire reborn, except its entirely better in almost every way visually, movement wise, and especially the roguelite elements themselves. And this game only claims to have half the content it will in the final release. Any roguelite fans who have played a shooter or two in the past will adore this game. Hell, my girlfriend doesn't even play any games and she enjoys watching me play this more than any other game cause the artstyle is so visually appealing to the eyes when someone is just mercing the f uck out of robots. Buy the game before the price hulks, you wont regret it

also headbonk till im dead

The game is only in early access, and I can already tell it's an amazing game, and it has tons of polish already. Some of the guns and characters as well as bosses need some balancing. Not all the game's content is available right now, including the main story missions.
Imagine DOOM(the new one) meets a classic FPS aim trainer, squeeze some roguelite base attending in there, some absolutely solid gameplay, and with some sick as hell soundtrack beats by Noisecream that make you feel like you're constantly in a shootout to the death with hundreds of robots. (Which is apt, because you are, in fact.)
As of right now, I typically find myself going for the same weapons, usually with the same stats, and often on the same character. This is why I say they do need a bit more balancing. Some of the builds are simply far better than others, with some weapons being practically mandatory if you see them.
The game also has multiplayer! Which I haven't tried yet, because none of my friends own the game yet, so I can't comment.
All in all: A REALLY good time. This game will make you feel like a badass robot blasting machine, and the more I play (which I can't seem not to do) the faster and better I get at hitting all my shots, which will just make you feel like even more of a badass.
